# Application-Manager

This is an easy to use Manager for your job-applications.

Did you ever struggle with the massive ammount of data, errors, the linkedIn search or creating a CV?

Then is this your go to app for job-applications.

You can:
* [x] Manage your applications: `/jobs`
* [x] Manage the Job Titles your are looking for: `/job_ids`
* [ ] Auto apply: Sends a prefab(generated by the user) to the company.
* [x] Import Jobs from LinkedIn to have a better overview: `/linkedin`
* [ ] Generate your own CV in easy mode(This will require knowledge from my side-project: `cv-template`)
* [x] Easy job application report export in json format
* [ ] Easy job application report export in csv format
* [ ] Auto-extract the phone-number, e-mail & address from the linkedin job page.
* [ ] Set the job application timestamp.
